description: This Java source file defines an enum 'ResponseType' which enumerates different types of responses (ERROR, NACK, RESPONSE) used in a request-response communication system. The enum provides methods to retrieve a ResponseType instance from a string name, get the name of the response type, and implements CharSequence methods for string-like behavior.

classes.name: ResponseType
classes.description: An enumeration of different response types for a request, implementing CharSequence for string-like behavior, providing methods for name retrieval and mapping from string names.

methods.name: fromName
methods.description: Returns an Optional<ResponseType> based on the provided name string, case-insensitive, matching one of the enum values.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the ResponseType enum instance.
